properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive dependency of the crypto-browserify/elliptic polyfill chain locked in the applets' webpack build (mpvue WeChat mini-program). Ships in node_modules on npm install; no direct call site in the mini-program source — presence is the dependency-inventory fact.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: evp_bytestokey@^1.0.3 is the OpenSSL EVP_BytesToKey single-round MD5 KDF used inside browserify-aes to derive AES keys from passwords in the Node-crypto browser polyfill. Locked in the applets build; not invoked directly by mini-program code.

components.name: Java JSSE sessions on default settings (at least JDK 8)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: jsrsasign@8.0.24 is the JS crypto backend of fabric-client@~1.4.20 (a direct dependency of the trace webapp, lockfile line 1491), supplying X.509 parsing, cert verification and RSA signature capability to the Fabric SDK that signs every blockchain trace transaction. Known-vulnerable provider version (CVE-2021-30185, CVE-2022-2841).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: create-ecdh@4.0.4 is part of the crypto-browserify polyfill chain in the applets' webpack build: classic ECDH key agreement is available to any bundled code that imports Node's crypto API. No direct call site in the mini-program source; the lockfile entry is what the build ships.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@0.14.5 (same package as the X25519 and XSalsa20-Poly1305 objects) is a transitive dep of the crypto-browserify chain in the applets build; Ed25519 signing is available in shipped node_modules. No direct call site in the mini-program source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.3 is the EC crypto library of the crypto-browserify/browserify-sign polyfill chain in the applets' webpack build (6.5.3 is the release that fixed the 6.5.2 invalid-curve timing issues). ECDSA available to bundled code; no direct call site in the mini-program source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@0.14.5 provides X25519 scalar multiplication (nacl.box / scalarmult) inside the crypto-browserify chain of the applets build — retroactively breakable key agreement if ever invoked. No direct call site in the mini-program source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2@3.1.1 is the browserify PBKDF2 (HMAC-SHA-256) polyfill, a transitive dep of crypto-browserify in the applets' webpack build. Iteration count is decided by callers of the polyfill — none exist in the mini-program source. Same logical asset as the pbkdf2 library object LIB-ea49d4c1.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sjcl@1.0.7 is a direct dependency of fabric-client@~1.4.20 (webapp lockfile line 2048) — the Fabric SDK's CryptoSuite_ECDSA_AES uses sjcl for its AES paths. Shipped in the trace webapp that signs every blockchain transaction; the only direct-use crypto in this webapp flows through fabric-client.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@0.14.5 secretbox (XSalsa20-Poly1305 AEAD) is available via the crypto-browserify chain in the applets' webpack build. Authenticated encryption available to bundled code; no direct call site in the mini-program source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: jsrsasign@8.0.24 (direct dependency of fabric-client 1.4.20 in the webapp) parses and validates the X.509 certificate material of the Hyperledger Fabric network — CA certs, enrollment certs and the hfc-key-store user certs handled by the trace webapp.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto provider for the trace webapp: jsrsasign@8.0.24 supplies RSA, ECDSA, X.509 and more to fabric-client@~1.4.20, the SDK that signs every chaincode transaction. Known-vulnerable provider version (CVE-2021-30185, CVE-2022-2841); quantum-vulnerable classical algorithms. Changeable here via package.json.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto provider for the trace webapp: sjcl@1.0.7 supplies AES to fabric-client 1.4.20's CryptoSuite_ECDSA_AES — the crypto suite instantiated by every webapp Fabric session (enrollAdmin.js, registerUser.js, all six traceapi modules).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sha.js@2.4.11 is the streamable SHA-1/SHA-256 implementation used inside the crypto-browserify polyfill chain of the applets' webpack build. No direct call site in the mini-program source; ships in node_modules on install.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.3 — the EC crypto library of the browserify-sign/crypto-browserify chain in the applets' webpack build. Supplies ECDSA (secp256k1/P-256 etc.) to any bundled code importing Node's crypto. No direct call site in the mini-program source; presence is the dependency-inventory fact.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js@1.1.7 — hash primitives (RIPEMD-160, SHA-1/2 family etc.) used by the elliptic/browserify chain in the applets' webpack build. No direct call site in the mini-program source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2@3.1.1 — the npm pbkdf2 package in the crypto-browserify polyfill chain of the applets' build. The package IS the PBKDF2 implementation (HMAC-SHA-256), so this library object is the same logical asset as the PBKDF2 algorithm object ALG-4de3b020, seen at its package-declaration site.
